items.q: Dave Brady had the band at the Dreamland.

ctx.x: Very quiet fellow. Both of them Simeons are play, Simeon, a very beautiful fellows. We used to hang out at the -- we clarinet players -- every night we could, we'd put on long pants and go in the cabaret, like the Royal Garden, where Joe Oliver was Earl Gardner, Oliver Willis and like Jimmy Noonan and Ed Beckstrom. Dave Brady had the band at the Dreamland. We used to go to all of them -- (unintelligible) fellows. learn from all those
Yeah. Well, I mean the thing is at that time that you're talking of the kind of jazz people in Chicago were influenced very much by these guys from Chicago, from and New Orleans.
